items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The guard `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):` (and its one-to-one counterpart) is short, says what it does, and follows the indentation and naming of the surrounding code. The existing comments still explain the block.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It is a minimal two-line guard in each method, reusing the existing field-cache API (`is_cached`) with no new bookkeeping. Repeating the guard in the two parallel prefetch methods mirrors the existing code structure. No dead code or debug leftovers.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It is a conservative conditional, with no exception handling or magic constants. The uncached case behaves as before, so a plain prefetch still fills in the reverse relation. Hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 85/85).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path is guarded by `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`, and ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset gets the same `if not self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj)` guard. The parent is still assigned when nothing is cached. The final report says the one-to-one path was not tested on its own.
